repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == false)
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait followed by actions. The candidate uses a periodic `if` that only evaluates at the start of the 1000ms wrapper period. Evidence F1 shows motion becomes true at t=0, and F2 confirms no action occurs at t=100ms because the condition is sampled too late. The candidate fails to block on the rising edge.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 1000ms (matching IR) and replaced the periodic polling `if` with a rising-edge state machine. The new script blocks until motion transitions to true, then executes the body exactly once per cycle, preserving the IR's timing and action sequence.
